primary_failure_modes.frequency: High (Recall drops to 28.4% on boxes < 32x32 pixels)
primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Receptive field downsampling in P5/P4 feature pyramid; fine hairline scratches lack sufficient pixel footprint
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: High-resolution inference (1024x1024) or slicing aided hyper-inference (SAHI)

primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Curved chrome bumpers and wet paint reflect sunlight streaks that mimic linear scratches
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: Polarized lens augmentation and brightness/contrast jittering

primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Side swiping scratches spanning entire vehicle side profile have aspect ratios > 10:1
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: Deformable convolutional layers or polygon masks

primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Deep paint scratches with slight metal indentation occupy visual continuum between deformation and surface abrasion
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: Multi-label classification head instead of mutually exclusive softmax

primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Cracks on painted plastic bumpers look identical to surface scratches at 224x224 crop resolution
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: Depth estimation priors or edge-enhanced high-pass filter channel

primary_failure_modes.mode: Fender vs Front Bumper Boundary Overlap
primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Wheel arch seam where plastic bumper wrap-around meets steel quarter fender

primary_failure_modes.mode: Door vs Rear Quarter Panel Boundary Overlap
primary_failure_modes.root_cause: Rear dog-leg panel contiguous with rear passenger door
Inherent subjectivity in human labeling of damage boundary between repairable (moderate) and total-replace (severe)
primary_failure_modes.mitigation: Ordinal regression loss (cumulative link models) rather than categorical cross-entropy

Structural frame rail misalignment requiring precision unibody jig bench realignment
High-cost OEM electronic modules (radar, lidar, adaptive cruise sensors behind plastic bumpers)
overprediction_primary_causes: Severe exterior cosmetic deformation where vehicle remained fully drivable and unibody stayed intact
Older vehicle models near salvage threshold where theoretical parts cost exceeds actual auction valuation
